primary_demo_reasons: External duplicate symptom is easy to explain without naming the invariant.
Four-module crash-window diagnosis demonstrates durable systems reasoning.
Visible then hidden restart/concurrency feedback supports a two-round interview narrative.
leakage_controls: Use parcel-domain names and no AgentForge class, table, state, or event names.
Do not include double consumption, idempotent resume, or exactly once in the task description.
Author tests independently from AgentForge regressions.
